prompt_text:
Continue the text below with exactly one short, natural, coherent English sentence. Return only the continuation, with no preamble or explanation:
There once lived an orphan pig, who lived in the deepest parts of the forest. They had no idea where they came from, nor did they have anyone else to protect them from the harshness in the world. However, they had a very strong spirit that allowed them to have an optimistic outlook in life. Despite their difficult youth, they grew up to adulthood, and planned on traveling elsewhere to build a more stable home.

One day, as they walked along the forest path, they stumbled upon a giant abandoned castle. It appeared to be in pristine condition, but no one appeared to live in it anymore. The pig was excited, for they thought that treasure might be found within the castle walls. The drawbridge was raised up, and a moat surrounded the castle. The water was deep, and it was not known what lurked underneath the surface. The pig cautiously walked up to the drawbridge, and looked around for a way to lower it. Seeing that the chains had rusted over time, they threw several rocks at it, hoping it would break. After several rocks, the chains finally broke, and the drawbridge fell into place. The pig was free to explore the castle, and what secrets it was hiding. The pig explored the massive castle, seeing most of it in disarming, and deterioration. The pig thought to himself that the previous occupants had escaped a unknown threat, while some had raised the drawbridge to keep the castle to themselves. They searched the castle far and wide and could not find any items of value. However, the pig was not one to give up easily, and continued their search for treasure. 

They eventually came across a locked door, and had decided to break it open. The door lead underground, and was poorly illuminated. Grabbing a nearby lantern , the pig ventured into the dark depths of what the castle had to offer. There, they found a massive underground room, with several skeletons laid about. They were pig skeletons, and they were all differently dressed in varying types of clothing.
reference_text: These were the ones that stayed behind in the castle, the pig thought, likely hiding from an enemy attack. He wondered if his ancestors were here, and what happened to them. Regardless, he was able to find what he had hoped to discover, a hidden room with piles of gold coins and other valuable items.
